actions_taken: The core proposal-splitter fix (parenthesised and bare-number formats) was already applied in the previous RSI run (commit 2c8d809). This run inspected the real ABBV 2026 filing text (seq=62741, 4 directors, 4 proposals) and identified two additional parser gaps: (1) reRatificationProposal matched 'ratification' and 'ratifying' but not 'ratified' (past tense) — ABBV uses 'The stockholders ratified the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP'; fixed by adding 'ied' to the alternation. Added real-data fixture file abbv_8k_5_07_2026.txt and test TestParseItem507_ABBV2026 that validates all four proposals are parsed and the 'did not approve' proposal is Passed=false.
